scope: Cache-only typed bridge context diagnostic proposal; source and gofmt only. No test, compiler, NATS or Docker execution.
changes: Non-authority bridge constructors return distinct private pointer leaves preserving old Error strings and authority sentinel identity.
No Unwrap, Is or As is added. The projector reads only exact private leaf types; retained standard context sentinels do not alter operational errors.Is or retry behavior.
Only existing executed context-error branches record the exact observed context sentinel. Nil context, time-remaining-only and localtls label-only branches remain opaque.
Actual terminal Request reply-wait context expiry preserves owner_bridge_reply_unavailable text while recording the originating context privately. Other NextMsg errors remain opaque.
Existing probe authority, malformed reply and cleanup ordering are unchanged; context cause is not attached to those errors.
controlLimits: The actual reply-wait control uses genuine pinned authenticated NATS and observes a real request at HOST without replying; existing controlled Docker inspection remains an explicit component seam.
It does not qualify an actual engine, original warm failure cause, wall-clock physical cleanup bounds, or the full installed lifecycle.
Constructed cleanup wrappers test projection priority only; existing owned transport controls remain separately required.
knownUnchangedGenericPaths: Request ordered flush or publish failure still returns connection_unavailable without inventing a cause.
Probe non-authentication LastError may remain reply_invalid ahead of deadline handling.
A deadline label from localtls without actual expired ctx remains request_failed.
